environment: Isolated native headless Overcooked! 2 runtime. Production executor and PhysX; fixture-supplied prepared ingredients before measurement. P1 stationary. Normal installed game unchanged.
selection: Latest retained completed measured observation per kitchen from sweeps 06 through 14. A timeout is not a completed dish. Each case carries its runtime DLL hash; earlier successes are not presented as reruns of the final binary.
